verdict.rationale: Proa documents first-party editor tools providing completion, hover, go-to-definition, rename and semantic highlighting inside `md!`/`md_sync!` templates. Those tools also flag a missing field in a paired Markdown view even when that view is not open, which covers both halves of the story (completion and inline errors). Compile-time template validation and typed props back up the type-error side, but they are build-time checks, not editor integration. Missing for 10: which editors/LSP clients are supported, explicit inline type-error reporting for HTML templates beyond `md!`, and independent or hands-on corroboration of accuracy.
